name: Tsuzuramaru
source:
Birthplace: Mutsu Province
Sword: Mumei (Nameless)
Style: Tamiya-ryu Iai

A samurai-in-training who comes to Edo from Mutsu Province. Following his teacher’s words, he left home in order to polish his swordsmanship. His goal is to win the Imperial Tournament of Sword Retrieval and receive the Book of Iai. Not attached to the past nor the future, he lives the way he wants to in the present. He has a black wood pigeon named Hayato.

[from [url=http://kokoronodamu.tumblr.com/post/36202686560/ken-ga-kimi-character-profiles/]kokoronodamu[/url]]
